webhooks.trigger_event: a product variant's inventory level rises above zero after being depleted
webhooks.note: fires on every inventory level change and delivers available quantity plus inventory_item_id; handler filters for transitions from zero to positive and resolves variant_id via a subsequent admin lookup
webhooks.description: Occurs whenever an inventory level is updated.
